These WebP fixtures were generated for this repository with Pillow 12.2.

- `animated.webp`: four lossless 160 × 96 RGBA frames. A colored rectangle moves
  across a transparent canvas. Durations are 40, 60, 80, and 100 ms; playback loops.
- `animated_benchmark.webp`: twelve lossy 640 × 360 RGB frames, quality 85. A
  rectangle and an ellipse move over a deterministic RGB gradient. Each frame
  lasts 40 ms; playback loops. Used only by the explicit performance benchmark.

Neither fixture contains downloaded images or user content.
